name: Global EbA Fund Small-Size Grants

funder.name: International Climate Initiative (IKI), German Federal Ministry for the Environment (BMUKN)

summary: Grants of up to USD 250,000 from the Global EbA Fund for catalytic projects that remove barriers to ecosystem-based adaptation, with a focus on small island developing states and least developed countries.

geography.label: Global or thematic projects, or ODA-eligible countries

reporting: Grantees must build at least three indicators from the Fund's Core Indicator Framework into their project logframe; the Fund uses them to monitor and report project outcomes.

calls.label: 8th Call for Proposals for Small-Size Grants

status.quote: Small-size grants will accept applications beginning 28 September and will close on 26 October.

administered_by.quote: Implemented by IUCN and UNEP, with funding from the International Climate Initiative (IKI) of the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)

applicant_types.quote: Non-governmental organisations (NGOs) International non-governmental organisations (INGOs) Intergovernmental organisations (IGOs) Community-based organisations (CBOs) Indigenous People's Organisations Universities and other academic institutions Research institutes and think tanks Private sector companies

geography.quote: Project is Global, Thematic, or otherwise targets only ODA-eligible countries.

access.quote: All applications must be submitted on the online platform.

amount.quote: Grant Size: each grant up to USD 250,000

reporting.quote: Applicants must identify at least three relevant indicators from the Core Indicator Framework and incorporate them into the individual project's logical framework.
